errors.what: Coupler appears longer than the specified 120 mm (about 135 mm relative to a 40 mm crank and 100 mm ground), so the linkage geometry is wrong. The panel rocker angle disagrees with the specification: at crank 0 the spec gives about 62.7 deg (B near (136.7, 71.1)) but the panel and drawing show 39.3 deg. At crank 180 the spec gives about 121 deg but the panel shows 112.5 deg.
